regime_context: Detector shows a two-tier risk-on structure: AI Infrastructure leads with moderate durability (0.68) but narrowing breadth (0.39 eligible) and fading valuation; Cybersecurity is the crowded challenger (z=1.8, breadth 1.0, durability 0.85); energy and equal-weight tech carry trend tags. The only validated leg is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), and the macro backdrop is dominated by unscheduled market/geopolitics headlines (75% unscheduled) — a noisy, coincident regime, not a clean trend. Cross-sectional rank has no predictive edge, so leans stay low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether AI Infrastructure's fading valuation state (val_state=fading) plus narrowing rotation breadth (eligible fraction 0.39) develops into a confirmed handoff to Cybersecurity — the observable condition is Cybersecurity closing the rank-score margin to AI Infrastructure below 0.20 for five consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: CIBR is the trend-health leader: hurst_tag=trend, durability_bar 0.85 (highest in eligible set), breadth 1.0 (every constituent participating). Cross-sectional rank is only a focus lens, but the trend-gate leg (the one validated edge) flags this as a holding worth staying with through shake-outs. Crowding z=1.8 is a size-down caution, explicitly not a sell.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.8 with headline attention often marks a local top in thematic ETFs; breadth 1.0 can be late-stage herding rather than durable rotation, and the macro regime (75% unscheduled, geopolitics-heavy) can trigger sharp derating of momentum names.

falsifier.text: CIBR lags SMH by 5% over the next 30 trading days

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: XLE holds a trend tag (hurst_tag=trend) with healthy breadth (0.727) and moderate crowding (z=0.83 — not extended). The absolute-trend gate is the only validated leg in this detector, and energy passes it while sitting rank=4 — a non-euphoric, un-crowded trend. This is a stability/trend-participation lean, not a momentum call.
theses.dissent: Energy trends are commodity-price driven; an unscheduled macro surprise (geopolitics headline share is high) can reverse oil/gas prices fast, and the equal-weight energy cousin at rank=6 has thinner breadth (0.667) suggesting the cap-weighted complex is doing the heavy lifting.

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 4% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: IGV proxy for non-AI software is crowded (z=1.11) with middling breadth (0.643) and durability equal to the market-wide gate (0.68), while its relative rank (11) is soft and score (0.55) is below the focus leaders. Avoidance here is a crowding-and-relative-weakness size-down posture — the detector gives no basis for a short, only for not allocating fresh flow to a crowded mid-momentum theme.
theses.dissent: Trend tag and eligible status mean it is still participating in the rally; crowding is only a sizing caution, and software can migrate toward AI-adjacent flows quickly in this regime — avoiding it may leave capital idle if the lead rotates back into mid-cap software.

falsifier.text: IGV outperforms SMH by 3% over the next 15 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
